Request:        undelete/ocsp/plainkey
Matching Route: ^undelete/(?P<path>.*)$

Undeletes one or more versions from the KV store.

## PARAMETERS

    path (string)

        Location of the secret.

    versions (slice)

        The versions to unarchive. The versions will be restored and their data will be returned on normal get requests.

## DESCRIPTION

Undeletes the data for the provided version and path in the key-value store.
This restores the data, allowing it to be returned on get requests.

versions.description: The versions to unarchive. The versions will be restored and their data will be returned on normal get requests.
